title: Model card before release

rules.description: A version merges or is released only if a model card for that exact version is present, with the sections intended_use, limitations, evaluation.
rules.condition: the model card is missing, describes another version or lacks one of intended_use, limitations, evaluation
rules.failure_mode: A model ships without the documentation that deployers and reviewers need to use it within its limits.

exceptions: Requested by the system owner, approved by the AI governance committee for at most 90 days, and recorded as a signed verdict override with an expiry.

extensions.notice: Illustrative, review before use. Indicative, not legal advice and not a conformity claim.
